name: Brunel Shipping for WooCommerce
author: Brunel Momentum

sections.description:
Brunel Shipping connects your WooCommerce store to Brunel Momentum for local same-day and next-day delivery.

Features

  • Live checkout rates — Same Day and Next Day options with delivery cutoff messaging at checkout (Classic and Blocks).
  • Secure store connection — Guided setup to link your WooCommerce store to Brunel Shipping.
  • Order sync — Import orders from WooCommerce into the Brunel merchant portal for label printing and fulfillment.
  • Delivery status write-back — Update WooCommerce order status when Brunel marks a package delivered.
  • Guided setup — Clear onboarding in WooCommerce admin, including connection status and activity.

Who is this for?

Canadian merchants using Brunel Shipping for last-mile delivery who want WooCommerce checkout to quote real Brunel rates and keep order status in sync with their carrier.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2+
  • WooCommerce 8.0+
  • A secure (HTTPS) store for production use
  • A Brunel Shipping merchant account (sign up)

Privacy / External service

This plugin connects your store to Brunel Shipping, an online delivery service. A Brunel merchant account is required (sign up). By installing, activating, and connecting the plugin, you authorize Brunel to process the information needed to quote shipping rates and fulfill deliveries.

What Brunel uses to serve your customers

  • At checkout, Brunel receives destination address details and package information needed to calculate shipping rates.
  • After you connect your store in the Brunel merchant portal, Brunel can sync orders and product information so you can fulfill deliveries and (optionally) show product promotions on branded tracking pages, and can update order status when a package is delivered.
  • Plugin settings stay on your WordPress site. Optional debug logging is off by default.

Privacy policy · Terms of use
sections.installation:
Getting Brunel rates at checkout takes a few minutes. Follow these steps in order.

1. Install the plugin

  1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Brunel Shipping for WooCommerce, then click Install Now and Activate.
  3. Or upload the plugin zip from Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, then activate it.

2. Open Brunel Shipping settings

Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Integration → Brunel Shipping.

You’ll see a connection hub with your store credentials.

3. Create your store connection

  1. Click Generate REST API keys.
  2. Copy the values shown on screen (they’re needed in the next step).
  3. Keep this page open while you finish setup in Brunel.

4. Connect Brunel to your store

  1. Sign in to your Brunel merchant portal (create an account first if you don’t have one).
  2. Open Settings → Integrations → WooCommerce.
  3. Paste the credentials you copied from WordPress into the matching fields.
  4. Save the connection.

5. Offer Brunel at checkout

  1. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Shipping → Shipping zones.
  2. Open the zone that matches your customers (for example a city or province zone — not only a country-wide zone if a more specific zone exists).
  3. Add the Brunel Shipping method to that zone and save.

You’re done. Shoppers in that zone should see Brunel Same Day / Next Day options at checkout when rates are available.
sections.faq:
Why do Brunel rates not appear at checkout?

Add the Brunel Shipping method to the most specific shipping zone that matches the customer address. If a regional zone matches first, a country-wide zone alone may not be used.

Does this work with modern WooCommerce?

Yes. Brunel Shipping works with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage and Checkout Blocks.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

Your Brunel connection settings are kept by default so a short deactivation does not force a full reconnect. You can clear them from the Brunel Shipping settings screen if you want a clean start.
